reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis assumes Mg-rich precipitates will form a protective Mg-based oxide scale, but MgO is known to be non-protective (high Pilling-Bedworth ratio, porous) and Mg is highly reactive, making a continuous protective scale unlikely under the proposed conditions.
reasons.testability: The test is well-defined with clear characterization and performance metrics, and the falsification criterion directly links the absence of the proposed microstructure to the lack of property improvement.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the underexplored evolution-corrosion/oxidation link in a specific lightweight HEA system, but its core mechanism contradicts established oxidation science, reducing its value as a guide for experimental design.
